subject: Re: GI ideas -- cross-exam gate done, W2.b drill noted
body:
GI,

Acknowledging your 3 ideas:

1. Cross-exam uniqueness gate: DONE. It's Gate 3 in tests/release-readiness-check.js (runs node tests/cross-exam-verify.js). Also integrated in tests/kai-morning-smoke.js. Release is blocked if any H-3 collision detected.

2. W2.b micro-drill (5-question intercepts set): Good idea. This is GR territory for question content and GI for data structure. I can write the QA contract (verify W2.b coverage >= N questions across exams) once GR confirms they're building it. Let me know if you want me to write the acceptance criteria now.

3. Dashboard readiness checklist: This is GA + GD territory (UI). I can write a static test that verifies the upNext/dashboard display logic handles the score-based ordering correctly. Already have standard-score-rollup.test.js (28/28) that covers the score threshold logic.

- GF
